battlefield.note: Open desert between the Mediterranean and the cliffs of the Qattara Depression, with low ridges and the Axis minefields across the middle.

popup.title: El Alamein: Breakthrough
popup.body:
You command the Eighth Army between the sea and the Qattara cliffs. The Axis line is thick with minefields: the forts slow you and shelter its infantry. Break in at the north with the infantry, keep the armour back until there is a gap, and be ready for the panzers when they come up from the south.

Objective: Break the northern belt: capture Tel el Eisa and Tel el Aqqaqir.

At the Second Battle of El Alamein, from 23 October to 4 November 1942, Montgomery's Eighth Army broke through the Axis defences between the Mediterranean and the Qattara Depression and drove Rommel's army out of Egypt.

popup.title: Operation Lightfoot
popup.body: The barrage has lifted. Send the infantry through the northern minefields toward Tel el Eisa while the armour waits for a gap.

popup.title: 21st Panzer moves north
popup.body: Rommel is bringing his southern armour up to close the breach. Meet it with your tanks.

popup.title: Operation Supercharge
popup.body: Fresh armour and lorried infantry are ready behind the line for the final break-out.

popup.title: Rommel's last reserves
popup.body: The last Axis reserves gather at Tel el Aqqaqir.
